name: lochinbekdev-security
description: Small, composable security-audit skills for backends: an orchestrator plus focused skills for authentication, authorization, API surface, uploads, dependencies and service trust boundaries, and a retest skill to verify fixes.

interface.longDescription: Eight read-only security skills that audit an authorized backend and produce one reproducible report: a backend orchestrator, focused skills for authentication, access control, API surface, file uploads, dependency supply chain and microservice trust boundaries, and a retest skill that verifies fixes against an earlier report. Every skill grills for scope before it touches a live system, writes nothing but the report, and marks any finding it could not confirm at runtime.
defaultPrompt: Use $audit-dependencies to audit the supply chain
